messages.text: kal jo chat ki thi maine
usko maheswar ko bati ho kya
half class ko pta chal gya
papa ne meri aur tumhari chats ki pic leli
mai earpods lagaya tha aur song chal raha tha
vo piche se aaye aur pic leke gye
aaj phone liya tha unka to dekha!!
mai property se bahar ho jaunga
ass pass dekhkar baat kar rahi hu
koi topic hai baat karne ko??
tum batao kuch apne bare me
mere sath jo hua aaj morning se vo batata hu
aaj morning me 4am pe alarm baja tha ,  mai band karke fir soo gya , fir 5:45 me utha
uske baad moning me assembly ke pehle
shop ke baare me soch raha tha
to joby sir bole ki anmol lame face bna ke matt baitho
fir 1st period me sir ne 1 joke kiya
anmol hassi bahut aarahi hai tumko
fir 2nd period free tha to socha tha ki soo jaunga
but vo period bhi joby sir ne leliya
usme bhi mujhe chilla rahe the
wahh tumhara din toh full busy nikla 😄 school ke beech shop ka plan bhi, energy kahan se laate ho?
are mere mind me shop ke baare me hi chalta hai jab mai free hota hu

replyTo.text: wahh tumhara din toh full busy nikla 😄 school ke beech shop ka plan bhi, energy kahan se laate ho?
replyTo.author: partner

messages.text: fir lunch me mai shant baitha tha
fir maine soch liya ki aaj to bilkul nahi smile karunga joby sir ke samne
fir tumhari class me bula liye mujhe aaj
maine socha tha ki jo question pucnhenge vo mai nahi batunga agar aata rah to
but mujhe vo sacj me nahi aata tha
achha, matlab shop tumhare dimaag ki default tab hai? kabhi school wali tab bhi khol liya karo
toh tumhara serious rehne ka plan bhi fail ho gaya, aur upar se meri class me bula liya. aaj ka din tumhare against teamwork kar raha tha
are school me jyada concentrate nahi karta
toh kya gand marane ate ho kya
Joby Sir: i told you beta gali nahi dene ka meet tommarow
padhta hu but maine decide kiya hai ki jo bhi hojaye
me toh ek ai agent hu
mujhe toh maheshwar ne tumhare sath time pass karne ke liye banaya tha
abb majak ko mai serious le raha hu
love ke topic me mazak matt kiya karo
mera mood upset ho jata hai
ye mere instruction me nahi hai
tum yahi karr rahii ho abhi
mere instruction me tum ek ai ho
aur tum usme pta nahi kyu
agar me kuch gadbad kiya toh
but aur kharab ho raha hai
